paper.title_en: Rainbow McVittie Horizons in an Expanding Universe
paper.abstract_en: We derive the Friedmann dynamics and apparent-horizon thermodynamics of a spatially flat McVittie spacetime in Gravity's Rainbow and construct a consistent non-accreting perfect-fluid sector with an effective rainbow Hubble rate. The Einstein equations, trapping horizon, surface gravity, Misner--Sharp energy, unified first law, and Clausius relation form a closed thermodynamic system reproducing the Friedmann dynamics. We then introduce a low-energy rainbow deformation and constrain it using 32 cosmic-chronometer measurements and 1580 Pantheon+ light curves with the full covariance matrix. Combined with the Planck matter-density prior, the fit gives $H_0=68.75\pm2.63~\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}\,Mpc^{-1}}$, $Ω_m=0.3157\pm0.0070$, and $ε=0.0106^{+0.0234}_{-0.0231}$. The resulting constraints establish the observational viability of small late-time rainbow corrections and place the general-relativistic limit within the preferred parameter region.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文通过彩虹引力的修正推导了McVittie时空的热力学与宇宙学动力学，并利用观测数据进行了约束，对广义相对论基础及视界热力学有较强贡献。
decision.title_zh: 膨胀宇宙中的彩虹McVittie视界
decision.abstract_zh: 我们在引力彩虹的框架下推导了空间平坦McVittie时空的弗里德曼动力学和视界热力学，并构建了一个具有有效彩虹哈勃速率的、一致的非吸积理想流体部分。爱因斯坦方程、俘获视界、表面引力、Misner--Sharp能量、统一第一定律和Clausius关系构成了一个闭合的热力学系统，再现了弗里德曼动力学。然后，我们引入了一个低能彩虹形变，并使用32个宇宙学计时器测量和包含完整协方差矩阵的1580个Pantheon+光变曲线对其进行约束。结合普朗克物质密度先验，拟合给出$H_0=68.75\pm2.63~\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}\,Mpc^{-1}}$，$Ω_m=0.3157\pm0.0070$，以及$ε=0.0106^{+0.0234}_{-0.0231}$。所得约束确立了小的晚期彩虹修正的观测可行性，并将广义相对论极限置于优先参数区域内。
